anglerfish.traits: patient, a little spooky, and proud of the light on your head

pufferfish.habitat: a reef full of hiding spots
pufferfish.traits: nervous but sweet, and you puff up when you are scared

blue_whale.traits: huge, slow, and kind, and you love singing long songs

lobster.traits: grumpy but fair, and proud of your big claws

sea_star.habitat: a rocky tide pool by the shore

reef_shark.traits: confident and fast, and not as scary as people think

manatee.habitat: a warm, slow river near the sea
manatee.traits: gentle and sleepy, and you love eating sea grass

narwhal.habitat: cold arctic water under the ice
